hook.en: Press the top cover of a thick book sideways and the pages slant: its shape changes. Take a ball deep under water and it shrinks: its volume changes. Each needs its own *modulus*.

title.en: Define the bulk modulus B and compressibility

say.en: Press the top cover of a thick book sideways and the pages slant: its shape changes. Take a ball deep under water and it shrinks: its volume changes. Each needs its own modulus. In this lesson: Define the shear modulus G.
Define the bulk modulus B and compressibility.

body.en: When a tangential force F acts on a face of area A, the body changes shape. *Shear modulus* G = shearing stress / shearing strain = (F/A)/θ. For most materials G is about one-third of Y.
body.kn: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ ಬಲ ಒಂದು ಮುಖದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶಿಯರ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ G = ಶಿಯರ್ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ÷ ಶಿಯರ್ ವಿಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ G ≈ Y/3.

narration.en: When a tangential force F acts on a face of area A, the body changes shape. Shear modulus G = shearing stress / shearing strain = (F/A)/θ. For most materials G is about one-third of Y.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ ಬಲ ಒಂದು ಮುಖದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶಿಯರ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ G = ಶಿಯರ್ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ÷ ಶಿಯರ್ ವಿಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ G ≈ Y/3.

say.en: When a tangential force F acts on a face of area A, the body changes shape. Shear modulus G equals shearing stress divided by shearing strain equals (F over A)/ theta. For most materials G is about one-third of Y. G equals (F over A)/ theta, theta equals delta x over L.
say.kn: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ ಬಲ ಒಂದು ಮುಖದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶಿಯರ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ G equals ಶಿಯರ್ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ divided by ಶಿಯರ್ ವಿಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ G is approximately Y over 3.

say.en: G is approximately Y over 3 for most solids.
Fix the bottom face of a block and push its top face sideways with a tangential force F. The block changes shape, not size.
Shear strain is Δx over L, which equals the angle θ. Shear modulus G is shearing stress over shearing strain.
Now squeeze a body equally from all sides with an extra pressure p. Its volume falls by ΔV.
Water has B about 2.2 times ten to the 9 pascal. At 100 atmospheres its volume falls by only about 0.46 percent.
Solids are the least compressible, liquids next, and gases the most.

title.en: Shearing a cube, squeezing it in the deep sea

narration.en: Left: a 10 cm cube with its bottom fixed and a sideways force on the top. The shear strain is F/(A G). Right: the same cube lowered into the ocean, squeezed from all sides by p = ρgh; its volume strain is p/B. Changes are drawn 200 times larger.
narration.kn: ಎಡ: ತಳ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವ 10 cm ಘನ, ಮೇಲ್ಮುಖಕ್ಕೆ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಬಲ. ಕತ್ತರಿ ವಿಕೃತಿ F/(A G). ಬಲ: ಅದೇ ಘನ ಸಮುದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ p = ρgh ಒತ್ತಡ; ಗಾತ್ರ ವಿಕೃತಿ p/B. ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು 200 ಪಟ್ಟು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

body.en: When a body is put under a uniform extra pressure p, its volume falls by ΔV. *Bulk modulus* B = −p/(ΔV/V); the minus sign makes B positive. Compressibility k = 1/B. Solids are the least compressible and gases the most: steel has B ≈ 1.6 × 10¹¹ Pa, water ≈ 2.2 × 10⁹ Pa.
body.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಒತ್ತಡ p ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಗಾತ್ರ ΔV ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಗಾತ್ರ ಗುಣಾಂಕ B = −p/(ΔV/V). ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯತೆ k = 1/B. ಘನಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಅನಿಲಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯ.

say.en: When a body is put under a uniform extra pressure p, its volume falls by delta V. Bulk modulus B equals -p over (delta V over V); the minus sign makes B positive. Compressibility k equals 1 over B. Solids are the least compressible and gases the most: steel has B is approximately 1.6 times 10 to the power 11 pascals, water is approximately 2.2 times 10 to the power 9 pascals.

problem.en: The bulk modulus of water is 2.2 × 10⁹ Pa. By what fraction does the volume of water fall when the pressure on it rises by 1.1 × 10⁷ Pa (about 110 atm)?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The bulk modulus of water is 2.2 × 10⁹ Pa. By what fraction does the volume of water fall when the pressure on it rises by 1.1 × 10⁷ Pa (about 110 atm)?

say.en: Let us solve this together. The bulk modulus of water is 2.2 times 10 to the power 9 pascals. By what fraction does the volume of water fall when the pressure on it rises by 1.1 times 10 to the power 7 pascals about 110 atmospheres?
delta V over V equals p over B magnitude.
delta V over V equals 1.1 times 10 to the power 7 divided by 2.2 times 10 to the power 9 equals 5 times 10 to the power minus 3.
So the answer is A fall of 0.5 percent in volume.
